records.outcome: Happiest Plants reports that seeds acquired from Eddy Pranoto at a Bangkok show grew into small seedlings, naming Blue Pap as mother and a BVEP × Dorito Portillae hybrid as pollen donor. This is seller-attributed breeder information, not breeder-direct confirmation.
records.uncertainty: Only the outer seed/pollen direction is source-reported; internal roles in the entire pollen hybrid are unknown. Source wording BVEP/Antolakii is preserved without authenticating identity or synonymy. Blue Pap remains an unresolved trade identity, with no pure-species assignment. No direct Blue Pap × BVEP event, intermediate success, adult outcome, fertility or connection to a user specimen is inferred. Crossing dates are unknown. Excluded from the successful-cross graph because compound parent identities are unresolved.
